label: Masuccio's Novellino
summary: The short story collection of Masuccio Salernitano, mined for Leonardo's word lists.

claims.statement: Entered as no. 38 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Literature, Poetry and Fables. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "the little works of Masuccio".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Il Novellino. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed 1475 · Printed 1476.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition
